verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical left-to-right leaderboards with a sensible headline, copy, product and CTA order. Both share the same flaws: 'WEEKEND ONLY' and the legal line under the button are microscopic and unreadable, and there is a dead gap between the body copy and the product. A centres the can neatly inside its peach circle, so the cluster looks deliberate. In B the smaller can sits off-centre against the circle's left edge, which looks accidental, and the button is slightly heavier.
